description: HIFLD Open National Inventory of Dams (NID) is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), United States Department of Homeland Security. A Brief History of the NIDThe site we see today was first conceptualized in the 1970s when Congress tasked the U.S. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
